note: The programs COP reads and how it draws them. Each program's name, family, feed, site, fresh_hours and stale_hours live in the doctrine kit's suite registry (doctrine/kit/vocab/programs.json, kit 0.4.0, 1 Nov 2026); tools/snapshot.py merges them in, and a program missing there stops the build. Colours are Okabe-Ito hues by program family (COP design spec, 29 Oct 2026); outlines carry the 3:1 contrast against each basemap. Freshness: older than fresh_hours is late, older than stale_hours (or no data at all) is stale and draws grey; it is measured from the newest data_as_of in the feed, or from the feed's own generated_at when freshness is 'feed' (for notice programs, whose items carry issue dates). country_mark says how country-level items draw: 'fill' shades the country, 'halo' rings its label point. area_style 'dashed' draws polygons as legal or administrative areas. routine_in_preset shows a program's routine items whenever its own preset is chosen (for standing notices, which are routine by nature). strength rules say where an anomaly's size is found; the first rule whose 'when' matches applies, and rules rank in the order listed. Strength ranks a program's own anomalies only, never across programs.
